verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David; to make memorial.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, to bring to remembrance.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder.

verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، إِلَى تَنْجِيَتِي. يَارَبُّ، إِلَى مَعُونَتِي أَسْرِعْ.
verses.en: O God, to deliver me, O LORD, to help me, make haste.
verses.kjv: [Make haste], O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
verses.web: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

verses.he: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חֹור וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.ar: لِيَخْزَ وَيَخْجَلْ طَالِبُو نَفْسِي. لِيَرْتَدَّ إِلَى خَلْفٍ وَيَخْجَلِ ٱلْمُشْتَهُونَ لِي شَرًّا.
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and abashed that seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and brought to confusion that delight in my hurt.
verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

verses.he: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח ׀ הֶאָֽח׃
verses.ar: لِيَرْجِعْ مِنْ أَجْلِ خِزْيِهِمُ ٱلْقَائِلُونَ: «هَهْ! هَهْ!».
verses.en: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame that say: 'Aha, aha.'
verses.kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.web: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

verses.he: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ ׀ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: وَلْيَبْتَهِجْ وَيَفْرَحْ بِكَ كُلُّ طَالِبِيكَ، وَلْيَقُلْ دَائِمًا مُحِبُّو خَلَاصِكَ: «لِيَتَعَظَّمِ ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.en: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; and let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'Let God be magnified.'
verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיֹון֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה־לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَمِسْكِينٌ وَفَقِيرٌ. اَللَّهُمَّ، أَسْرِعْ إِلَيَّ. مُعِينِي وَمُنْقِذِي أَنْتَ. يَارَبُّ، لَا تَبْطُؤْ.
verses.en: But I am poor and needy; O God, make haste unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, tarry not.
verses.kjv: But I [am] poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou [art] my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
verses.web: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
